headline: 14-5 on 22 Nov (74%), with all six back-to-back and heavy-underdog legs (SAC, NOP) hitting. Misses were mostly the ball going elsewhere: Maxey took 11 shots while Embiid scored 26, and Coward's assists dried up with Ty Jerome back. Gobert missed by half a point.
Pattern moves: team dog by 10+ now +16pp better (72%, 13 team-games, still a candidate), and the B2B gap halved to +9pp after tonight's 6-0.

misses.why: Normal minutes and shot volume (7 FGA) but went 1-7; his third PTS miss.
Ty Jerome back (27 min, 6 ast) probably took the creation while Coward scored 23 on 16 shots.
Only 2 shots (avg 6.1) despite extra minutes; missed by half a point.
Normal minutes but 11 shots vs avg 16 (4-11) while Embiid (26) and Simons (18) took the scoring.
Minutes down 3.3 in a 1-point game as Shamet (36 min) and Alvarado took the guard time; only 4 shots.

hits_note: Jeremiah Fears REB o3.5 (5): hit against Wembanyama (19.0 REB/48, elite) with star big Missi back (13 boards). Both new REB conditions were present and he cleared anyway.

Derik Queen PTS o7.5 (15): hit in a 23-point loss, playing 35 minutes against a 19.9 average with Missi back. Short-handed NOP (no Zion, Murray or Murphy) kept its starters on. The blowout didn't cost him minutes.
Saddiq Bey AST o1.5 (2): shot 1-12 and still squeaked through in a blowout. That's lucky.
Darius Acuff AST o5.5 (8): hit on a 7-23 shooting night, a second counterexample to "scoring nights kill AST overs". His AST is now 3-0 in the log.
Myles Turner REB o4.5 (6): fouled out with 6 personal fouls but still played his normal 26 minutes. More evidence that fouls aren't a minutes marker.
adds: Usage going elsewhere is still the main miss shape (Maxey, Coward, Gobert). It's always a teammate's big night or a returning playmaker. Nothing pre-game flagged any of them.

New: heavy-underdog players went 6-0 (SAC +12.5, NOP +19.5). "Team dog by >= 10" is now 72% vs 56% (13 team-games). It's suggestive but a long way from 30 team-games, and both games were short-handed or B2B, so the flags overlap.
The B2B gap fell from +16pp to +9pp because all six B2B items were those same dog legs. The two flags are tangled and need splitting.
Three hits came in by half a point (LaVine, Maxey AST, Avdija). Gobert lost by half a point the other way. Tonight's 74% has some luck in it.
